title: MZ Error "Cannot read propety 'pages' of undefined" when loading

posts.author: ThankYouForEverything
posts.body:
Hello, I'm trying to make various custom image based menus ( just so that I can make them look more customized and pretty), but I've been running into a problem where if I try to continue/load a game from my custom title menu (located on a map, I'm using ZainWD title skip plugin), it gives me an error saying "Cannot read propety 'pages' of undefined". I tried some other ways of loading the game but they either give the same error or they just don't load anything, just goes back to the title menu and resets it.
(Btw when I put 2 events on a map that call the Save common event and Load common event, and save from one of them and load using the other, it works perfectly, loads everything as it should be as far as I can see it, I think this is an important bit of information that might narrow down where the problem is coming from. Also, when I push scene load, instead of calling my Load common event, and load the file I saved using my custom Save common event, it works as intended, so I'm guessing the problem is not with how the save event is set up.)

posts.body:
Let's start at the very end.
"Cannot read property 'pages' of undefined"
I haven't used MZ myself, but from VXA onward the only data object that has pages would be a map event - nothing else can have multiple pages.
So your error tells you that the engine tried to process an event that does not exist.
Likely because it was overwritten by the load process itself.

posts.author: caethyril
posts.body:
Based on what you've said, it does sound like it could be related to event counts. E.g.
Save on map A, with 2 events.
Go to map B, with 3 events.
From map B, load the save made on map A (with fewer events).
Game tries to update events 1~3?
=> Error! Can't update event 3 because it doesn't exist on map A.
Even if that is the case, though, at the moment I can't see why that kind of thing might happen. Maybe it's to do with the player transfer sequence or something...

Hi! It's been a while, I just noticed I didn't respond to this post, but I did see it at the time.
I tried turning off all plugins and it still didn't work, but it's ok.
I talked to someone on reddit about how they made their custom picture based load menu work, and they gave me the same solution they used, which was modifying the scene_load so that when it gets called, it loads a file instantly without user input, and it loads the file number based on a variable, which would be the same variable used for the current selected cursor of the custom image based scene, like:
>Cursor variable is 3
>Call the Load menu
>The Load menu automatically loads file 3, since cursor variable is 3
(at least that's what I understood that happens lol)
I just wanted to say thank you for helping me, I really appreciate it!

Yea, I've since
updated Cae_Tweaks to v18
, adding a "safe mode" to feature D21 (enabled by default). It works in a similar way to what you describe: the plugin's "load" command goes to a custom scene, which loads the requested save then returns to the map scene.
(I'm still not certain exactly what causes the error with the "not safe" approaches, but I'm pretty sure a complete scene change should prevent it.
)
Good to know you found a solution!
